verdict.rationale: A government tax agency's online accounts could plausibly offer bulk export of a user's records in open formats, so this axis applies. The evidence only documents registering, filing, submitting documents, making payments and viewing EFILE transmission history. None of it shows a full data export in open formats or an exit or portability path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
